name: Penhalt Farm Holiday Park
accommodation: Touring and camping pitches (some hardstanding) on 8 acres, plus a bungalow, farmhouse flat and holiday caravan
beachAccess: About a mile south of Widemouth Bay
confirmedFeatures: Hardstanding pitches, electric hook-up, WiFi, showers
overview: An eight-acre farm park about a mile south of Widemouth Bay, set up for touring caravans and campers with some hardstanding pitches. Alongside the pitches it lets a bungalow, a farmhouse flat and a holiday caravan.
surfTripFit: A mile from Widemouth's beach breaks, with a choice of pitches or a fixed roof for the crew.
